cohorts_price_range.name: cohorts_price_range
cohorts_price_range.value: "cohorts"."price_pence" between 1 and 10000000 and ("cohorts"."was_price_pence" is null or "cohorts"."was_price_pence" > "cohorts"."price_pence")

coupons_value_range.name: coupons_value_range
coupons_value_range.value: ("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."value" between 1 and 100) or ("coupons"."kind" = 'amount' and "coupons"."value" between 1 and 10000000)

coupons_dates_order.name: coupons_dates_order
coupons_dates_order.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."starts_at" < "coupons"."ends_at"

courses_kind_shape.name: courses_kind_shape
courses_kind_shape.value: ("courses"."kind" = 'shared' and "courses"."organisation_id" is null and "courses"."parent_id" is null) or ("courses"."kind" = 'provider' and "courses"."organisation_id" is not null)

organisations: read where member.name: organisations: read where member
organisations: read where member.using: exists (select 1 from public.organisation_members m where m.organisation_id = "organisations"."id" and m.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

payouts_second_approver.name: payouts_second_approver
payouts_second_approver.value: "payouts"."approved_by" is null or "payouts"."created_by" is null or "payouts"."approved_by" <> "payouts"."created_by"
